text: Safety glasses go on before any tool comes out.
They stop chips and dust from hitting your eyes.

tip.text: Regular glasses are not safety glasses. Wear safety glasses over them.

text: Loud tools can hurt your hearing, even if it does not hurt right away.
Ear muffs or ear plugs keep your ears safe.
Sanding makes fine dust that you should not breathe.
Wear a dust mask when you sand or sweep.
Wear closed-toe shoes in the shop.
Boards and tools can fall, and your toes are worth protecting.

tip.text: Gloves are for carrying rough boards, not for using spinning tools.
